newsitem.title: USA: North Fork to acquire Branford.
newsitem.headline: North Fork to acquire Branford.

text.p: North Fork Bancorp Inc said Friday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Branford Savings Bank in a stock for stock exchange valued at about $38 million.

Under the terms of the agreement, each share of Branford common stock would be exchanged for $5.25 of North Fork common stock. North Fork also received an option to acquire up to 19.9 percent of Branford's voting common stock at a price of $4.75 per share, should certain events occur.
North Fork said it believes, based upon anticipated cost savings, that the transaction would not dilute earnings per share in 1998.
The company expects the transaction to be consummated by the end of the year.
